title: Closed subsets of a quasi-compact space are quasi-compact
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the standard inheritance of quasi-compactness by closed subsets (author lemma at source lines 1878-1881, label lemma-closed-in-quasi-compact). The proof (source lines 1883-1891) enlarges an open covering of the subset to one of the ambient space by adding the complement, applies quasi-compactness, and discards the added member (proof lines 1884-1890). Together with the companion statement that quasi-compact subsets of a Hausdorff space are closed, this is the pair used throughout the chapter's compactness arguments. H2.
